detail: Traded from Toronto to the Clippers in the Kawhi Leonard deal

sources.text: Going to the Clippers in a bench role. He was out of Toronto's rotation for much of last season. Not draftable. His game isn't fantasy friendly.
sources.quote: We're not We're not drafting Dick. He's not good. He does not have a particularly fantasy friendly game.

detail: Outside the projected top ten of the Clippers rotation, with no clear path to minutes

sources.text: Dick was bad last season and fell out of Toronto's playoff rotation, which is notable for a supposed elite shooter. He has no clear path to minutes, and the speaker is not interested.
sources.quote: So yeah, I'm not I'm just going to come out and say it. I am not interested in Dick.
